# Surfaced Studio

> > Surfaced Studio: Professional VFX, motion graphics, and filmmaking tutorials covering Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, and cinematic production techniques.

Surfaced Studio is a creative education platform specializing in visual effects, video editing, and post-production workflows. The site offers comprehensive tutorials, project showcases, and resources for filmmakers working with industry-standard tools like After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, 3dsMax, and DSLR cinematography.

## Key Topics

- Adobe After Effects
- VFX & Visual Effects
- Motion Graphics
- Colour Grading & Correction
- Premiere Pro
- Blender 3D
- Cinematic Look
- DSLR Filmmaking
- Post-Production
- Camera Shake & Expressions
- 3D Integration
- Video Editing
- HitFilm
- Music Production
- Film Making Techniques

## After Effects Tutorials

- [How to get that Cinematic Look – Colour Grading](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/after-effects/cinematic-look-colour-grading): After Effects tutorial: achieve cinematic look through colour grading effects
- [Adobe After Effects Tutorial - How To Create Explosions](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/after-effects/explosions-in-adobe-after-effects): After Effects tutorial: creating realistic explosion VFX with compositing
- [Adobe After Effects Basics – Camera Shake](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/after-effects/after-effects-basics-camera-shake): After Effects basics: add camera shake using expressions & slider controls
- [Top 10 Adobe After Effects Shortcuts](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/after-effects/top-10-after-effects-shortcuts): Top 10 After Effects keyboard shortcuts for efficient workflow navigation
- [3D Integration VFX Part 4 – 3D Scene In 3dsMax](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/after-effects/3d-integration-vfx-part-4-3dsmax): 3dsMax & After Effects 3D integration VFX tutorial series part 4

## Video Editing & Post-Production

- [Premiere Pro Advanced Colour Correction - Surfaced Studio](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/premiere-pro/premiere-pro-advanced-colour-correction): Premiere Pro advanced colour correction: waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope
- [How To Loop A Video In Adobe After Effects](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/blog/updates/after-effects-how-to-loop-a-video): After Effects guide: loop videos using time remapping, expressions, interpret
- [Adobe Premiere Pro CC April 2017 - New Features Summary](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/blog/updates/adobe-premiere-pro-cc-april-2017): Premiere Pro CC April 2017 update: Essential Graphics, Sound panels, templates

## 3D & Blender Tutorials

- [Emissive Materials in Blender 2.9 - Surfaced Studio](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/blender/emissive-materials-in-blender): Blender 2.9 tutorial: using emissive materials for 3D scene lighting

## Filmmaking & Cinematography

- [Shutter Angle tutorial on how to make your DSLR video look like film](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/tutorials/film-making/shutter-angle-tutorial): DSLR filmmaking: shutter angle & motion blur for cinematic video look
- [Accessories for Film Makers](https://www.surfacedstudio.com/resources/accessories-for-film-makers): Film gear guide: Manfrotto tripods, Zoom audio recorders, microphones
